{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
data['customer_age'] = data['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Remove rows with revenue = '999,999.99' (QA orders)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
data_clean['revenue'] = data_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data_clean['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data_clean['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check cross-tabulation of channel and segment
channel_segment = pd.crosstab(data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and segment:")
print(channel_segment)

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = data_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Compute overall conversion rate
overall_conversion_rate = data_clean['converted'].mean()
print(f"\nOverall conversion rate: {overall_conversion_rate:.4f}")

# Check if the groups are comparable: are conversion rates confounded by segment?
# Compute conversion rate within each segment
conversion_by_segment_channel = data_clean.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by segment and channel:")
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)"}
